opening.argument: The presentation promotes Genesis as an income opportunity built around concrete earnings calculations and sponsored teams. It describes a participant spending $22 and turning that activity into $79.30 in the first month, while stating that the result leaves the participant with net profit. It also directs successful participants to tell friends, family, neighbors, and coworkers about the opportunity, and presents three-level override commissions through a structure in which recruited participants populate successive levels. Daily ad-viewing tasks are tied to earning Genesis Coins that can be redeemed for cash. Although an income disclaimer is included, it does not outweigh the repeated earnings calculations and direct recruitment appeal.
